root_cause: No termination condition for idle state — kept checking HANDOFF.md despite no handoffs in Timeline Governor section for 3 consecutive reads. Should have asked user for new direction or idled silently.
trace_summary: Read HANDOFF.md repeatedly (~4 times) finding no pending entries. Reported same status each time. User had to intervene to stop the loop.

failure_signature.agent_behavior: Kept polling a static file for changes that weren't coming, burning tool calls and tokens
failure_signature.agent_mechanism: No circuit-breaker on repeated reads of unchanged data — should limit to 1 check per user request
